name: Flat burrito
summary: Flat burrito: wrapped tortilla cut open to show rice, beans and filling, with half a foil wrap. For Mexican food scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the burrito rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~420 px wide); use about 0.2 to 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = rock on its base, pop = scale in
